events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese is an English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer, widely known as a co-founder of Monty Python and for starring in Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: Celebrating the comedic genius that is John Cleese as he turns 87! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released on November 22, 1968, featuring a diverse range of genres and a plain white sleeve.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. An iconic, eclectic masterpiece that still sparks debate. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45, leaving behind a monumental legacy in music.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: 59 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A landmark album that pushed boundaries. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon, a founding member of The Beatles, was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, and would have been 86 in 2026.

angles.name: Lennon's Impact
angles.copy: On this day, we reflect on the immense talent and enduring message of John Lennon. His music and vision continue to inspire.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, the influential and innovative musician, would have celebrated his 80th birthday on January 8, 2027.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman, David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. An artist who continually reinvented sound and style.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll,' was born on January 8, 1935, and would have been 92 in 2027.

angles.name: King of Rock's Birthday
angles.copy: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves with his timeless tracks.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Jimmy Page, the legendary guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, turns 83 on January 9, 2027.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped generations of rock music. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday on January 10, 2027.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! Still rocking, still crooning, still got that distinctive voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the charismatic frontman of the band Madness, turns 66 on January 13, 2027.

angles.name: Madness Frontman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th to the one and only Suggs from Madness! Still bringing the house down after all these years. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Paul Young, the English singer known for his soulful voice and 80s hits, celebrates his 71st birthday on January 17, 2027.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! That voice defined a generation. What's your go-to Paul Young classic?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Legendary country music icon Dolly Parton, who passed away in August 2026, would have celebrated her 81st birthday on January 19, 2027.

angles.name: Dolly's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. Her music and spirit continue to shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Gary Barlow, lead singer of Take That and a highly successful songwriter, turns 56 on January 20, 2027.

angles.name: Take That's Main Man
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo hits, a true British music icon.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of international R&B and pop hits, celebrates his 77th birthday on January 21, 2027.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the legend that is Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams, get into our cars, and turn up his hits!

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Anniversary
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on January 23, 1986, honouring rock's pioneering artists.

angles.name: Rock Legends Recognised
angles.copy: On this day in 1986, the first legends were inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame. Who would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Mark Owen, a member of the hugely successful pop group Take That, turns 55 on January 27, 2027.

angles.name: Take That's Mark's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still got that boyband charm and plenty of hits.

events.title: Beatles Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic and final public live concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London on January 30, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Award-winning drummer and singer-songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday on January 30, 2027.

angles.name: Phil the Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! A drumming icon and hitmaker. What's your favourite Phil track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake turns 46 on January 31, 2027.

angles.name: JT's Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the Prince of Pop, Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo stardom, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.
